decision: Does standard low-rank matrix completion, the first comparator a machine-learning reviewer asks for once the task is framed as matrix completion, match or beat AnchorBoost and interpolation? Whatever the answer, it is reported as measured.

method.name: SoftImpute (Mazumder, Hastie and Tibshirani, JMLR 11:2287-2322, 2010), Algorithm 1: Z <- S_lambda(P_Omega(X) + P_Omega_perp(Z)), S_lambda the singular-value soft-threshold, iterated to relative change ||Z_new - Z_old||_F^2 / ||Z_old||_F^2 < 1e-5 or 500 iterations; warm starts along a decreasing lambda path.
method.implementation: numpy only (numpy.linalg.svd, full_matrices=False), softimpute/softimpute_run.py; no third-party completion library.
method.matrix: Rows are chemicals; columns are the 35 package concentrations x 68 outputs flattened (2,380 columns, kit/data/matrix.npz). Observed cells: every measured cell of the fold's training chemicals, plus the revealed cells of the one test design being completed.
method.per_task: Each (test chemical, design) is completed in its own fit: training rows plus that single test row, warm-started from the training-only solution at the same lambda. No other test chemical and no other design of the same chemical enters the fit, so no target cell is ever observed.
method.centering: Column means of the training rows (columns without training data get mean 0) are subtracted before completion and added back; this is the candidate choice C below.
method.lambda: lambda = ratio x the largest singular value of the centered, zero-filled training matrix of the fold.

task: The kit (kit/protocol.json): same folds, designs, query cells, curve MAE, cohorts and scorer.

candidates.description: the best ratio of S1-S8 without centering

development.budget: 9 candidates, within the 11 allowed to every comparator family.
development.selection: Lowest fold-0 k = 3 MAE; within 0.002 of the lowest, the larger lambda (lower rank).
development.no_test_use: Fold 1-4 rows enter development only as training rows. No fold 1-4 completion is scored before the freeze is filled in.

frozen.note: Selected by the frozen rule before any fold 1-4 completion was made.

readouts.k3: Folds 1-4: MAE on primary_194 and common_193; paired differences against anchorboost, loglinear_interp, cnp, hill_eb, gp and anchorboost_acquisition with identity-group and chemical intervals (kit score.py).
readouts.k1_k2_k4: Same frozen settings; against anchorboost (published per-chemical), loglinear_interp and published_neural_process.
readouts.pmf: Probabilistic matrix factorization only if time remains after SoftImpute and TabPFN; its own protocol entry would be added before it runs.

expected_before_run.controller: MAE 1.30-1.40 at k = 3, between interpolation (1.345) and the kNN example (1.407); recorded as written by the controller (inference).
expected_before_run.writer: MAE 1.35-1.50 at k = 3: columns are absolute concentrations, so the method sees no dose-response smoothness and a test chemical tested off the common grid has query columns few training chemicals share. Probability below AnchorBoost (1.161) under 0.02; below interpolation about 0.3.
